rationale: C12 is a direct and material drafting template. The child repeats its two-part structure: section 1 transfers Bankhead-Jones lands and associated waters, improvements, and structures from Agriculture to Interior for administration under the Taylor Grazing Act, while section 2 withdraws suitable public lands and transfers jurisdiction to Agriculture. The operative language is substantially verbatim, with changed land descriptions and incorporation of the intervening amendment represented by C02. C02 is also strong evidence for the precise amended wording of section 1, but it supplied only that amended paragraph rather than the child's complete two-section framework. C21 shares land-withdrawal machinery but is much less distinctive and lacks the reciprocal departmental-transfer structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Subject to valid existing rights, jurisdiction over all lands in the following-described areas acquired or in the process of acquisition under Title III of the said Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act ... together with waters or water rights, improvements, and structures ... is hereby transferred to the Department of the Interior
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Subject to valid existing rights, jurisdiction over all lands in the following-described areas acquired or in process of acquisition under Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act ... together with waters or water rights, improvements, and structures ... is hereby transferred to the Department of the Interior
shared_material.explanation: C12 supplies nearly verbatim language defining the property and transferring jurisdiction from Agriculture to Interior.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the lands shall be administered, and shall be subject to exchange, under the Taylor Grazing Act ... Provided, that the transfer of jurisdiction over those lands that are in process of acquisition shall take effect upon the completion of acquisition thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the lands shall be administered under the Taylor Grazing Act ... Provided, That the transfer of jurisdiction over those lands that are in process of acquisition shall take effect upon the completion of acquisition thereof
shared_material.explanation: The child retains C12's Taylor Grazing Act administration and delayed-effect proviso, while incorporating the exchange language supplied by C02's amendment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: SEC. 2. Subject to valid existing rights and withdrawals ... the public lands within the following-described areas, being found suitable for the purposes of Title III ... are hereby withdrawn from all forms of appropriation under the public-land laws, except the mining and mineral-leasing laws ... and the jurisdiction thereover is transferred to the Department of Agriculture
shared_material.parent_excerpt: SECTION 2. Subject to valid existing rights and withdrawals ... the public lands within the following-described areas, being found suitable for the purposes of Title III ... are hereby withdrawn from all forms of appropriation under the public land laws, except the mining and mineral-leasing laws ... and the jurisdiction thereover is transferred to the Department of Agriculture
shared_material.explanation: This is a second, substantially verbatim operative provision, establishing that C12 supplied the child's overall reciprocal transfer-and-withdrawal framework rather than merely generic land-order phrasing.
